Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can. Even if you only reveal one of the applicable cards, you can still add it to your hand.
Card Q&A.q: If the 3 cards revealed for this card's [On Play] effect include only either 1 card with the [Puppet] trait or 1 card with the [LIBERATOR] trait, can I just add that 1 card to my hand?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. If you have cards that are targets of this effect, you must add as many cards to your hand as possible.
Card Q&A.q: If the 3 cards I reveal from my deck for this card's [On Play] effect include both a card with [Puppet] trait and 1 card with the [LIBERATOR] trait, can I choose to only add one of them to my hand, and place the remaining cards at the bottom of my deck?

Effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with the [Puppet] trait and 1 card with the [LIBERATOR] trait among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] All of your opponent's Security Digimon get -3000 DP.
